newsitem.title: JAPAN: Cosmo Oil to shut Sakaide topper mid-June to Aug 1.
newsitem.headline: Cosmo Oil to shut Sakaide topper mid-June to Aug 1.

text.p: Cosmo Oil Co Ltd said on Wednesday it will close its 140,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) crude distillation unit at its Sakaide plant in western Japan from June 13 to August 1 for routine maintenance.

The refiner also plans to shut down a 110,000 bpd topper at its Chiba plant, east of Tokyo, from May 12 to June 22, a company spokesman said. The other topper at the plant, with a processing capacity of 130,000 bpd, will be up and running through the year.

At Cosmo Oil's Yokkaichi plant in central Japan, a 75,000 bpd topper will be down for maintenance checks from September 16 to November 4, while the other topper with a capacity of 80,000 bpd will be operational throughout the year.
Maintenance closures are not scheduled for a 110,000 bpd topper at its Sakai plant in Osaka, western Japan, he added.
